g.text: Query validity is first token ID > 0.
Returned logits are per patch and per requested class.
Logit normalized corner and patch-size priors
All prediction-head Linear layers include bias.

Scale to the original image dimensions
Boxes, confidence and requested class IDs
Objectness logits are a separate returned branch.
No DETR query decoder or FPN exists in this graph.
Nv includes CLS; Np is patch count. Ev/Et: tower widths; nv/nt: repeats; hv/ht: heads; Mv/Mt: MLP widths; D: text projection.
